## History

Harmon Andrews is a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whose community is struck by a severe and destructive storm of hail and lightning following an unexpected weather prediction by [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P33](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0033), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews shares a family connection with [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md). His involvement in her life includes a notable incident during a boat ride at a picnic, where he saved her from falling overboard by catching her by her sash.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P67](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), +1 more_

- Saved by — caught her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
